idea-plugin.name: WLZN OSS Browser
idea-plugin.description:
Manage Alibaba Cloud OSS and Amazon S3 directly in IntelliJ IDEA.

Multi-account connections, secure credentials, bucket and folder browsing, resumable uploads and downloads, transfer queue, preview and editing, copy/move/rename/delete, signed links, ACL, metadata and multipart management.

在 IDEA 中管理阿里云 OSS 与 Amazon S3，支持多账号、安全密钥存储、文件夹浏览、 断点续传、传输任务、预览编辑、复制移动、临时链接和对象管理。
